purpose: Present the three commercial plans side by side without publishing prices, so every plan card routes the visitor to a sales conversation (work-email capture) instead of a checkout. A startup-programme banner underneath offers a discount path to a specific audience.

behaviour.note: No prices anywhere: each plan card has a name, a one-line tagline, a work-email input with a 'Talk to a human' primary button, a bullet list of allowances, and a footer. The plans are Core, Pro and Enterprise (in that order).

Email capture: required, type=email, validated client-side as a work (business) email; an invalid value shows a field error and blocks submit. A valid value navigates to /get-started?source=pricing and hands the email over via router state (not in the URL). The clone sends nothing to a server; the original posted to a capture API.

Card colours: default cards use gray-1; the second card (by position, nth-child 2) uses gray-3; a card flagged dark (Enterprise) switches to the dark theme on gray-10. The two cards without a dark flag show a 'Show full plan comparison' link with a down chevron to #compare-plans in the footer strip; the dark card shows its footer sentence instead.

Feature list: mono uppercase bullets, 5 to 6 items on Core and Pro; the Enterprise card has no features list (only tagline and the footer sentence). Allowance figures are stated per user per month or per org.

Startup programme banner spans the full grid width under the cards: a 288x288 square thumbnail (shown 80 to 128px), a bold title, a paragraph and two buttons ('Learn more' outline to /startups and 'See if you qualify' primary to /startups-apply-now).
Must be followed by content.plan-compare-table (the 'Show full plan comparison' link targets its #compare-plans anchor).
